column2: Question
column3: Why It Matters

column2: How many equip slots and can that number grow?
column3: Defines the entire balance model
column4: 3 fixed / start at 1 and unlock more / scales with total titles earned
column5: ANSWERED - 10 slots - fixed. Unique and Limited titles stack on top of the 10 and are budget-exempt.

column2: Single player or multiplayer first?
column3: Limited and Unique titles are meaningless in single player. Half the mod's identity depends on this
column4: SP-first with scarcity disabled / MP-first / both with a config toggle
column5: ANSWERED - multiplayer-first but single player must work just as smoothly. Same code path - the integrated server makes this free.

column2: NeoForge only or both loaders?
column3: Doubling loaders early roughly doubles the work
column5: ANSWERED - REVISED - Forge 47.x on 1.20.1 because every integration target is Forge-only. NeoForge after the port to 26.x. Still exactly one loader at a time - never two at once.

column2: Should titles be visible to other players?
column3: Drives whether this is a personal RPG sheet or a social status system. Given the multiplayer-first answer this now matters a lot more

column2: Do you want a title level or prestige system later?
column3: Changes the data model now - retrofitting levels is painful
column4: Flat titles / titles level up with continued progress

column2: What is the target playstyle - vanilla-plus or full RPG overhaul?
column3: Decides magnitude ranges. The 40-point budget assumes vanilla-plus. An overhaul would roughly double every number

column2: Should title effects work in PvP?
column3: Uncapped PvP scaling will get the mod banned from servers. With 10 slots this is now a bigger deal than it was at 3
column4: Full effect / reduced in PvP / config toggle

column2: Any conflict with existing mods in this space?
column3: Worth 20 minutes on Modrinth before naming it

column2: Do titles interact with each other?
column3: Set bonuses and synergies are a great hook. With 10 slots there is real room for them now
column4: None / synergy pairs / full set bonuses

column2: Server-wide or per-world scarcity on a multi-world server?
column3: Affects where the SavedData lives
column4: Per-world / global via a shared file

column2: What is the mod's actual name?
column3: Everything downstream uses the mod id

column2: Do you want an achievement-style completion reward?
column3: Earn 25 titles as a meta-title is a strong long-term hook

column2: Should the 40-point budget be flat or grow with progression?
column3: Flat means late players choose between titles forever. Growing means the cap is a progression track of its own
column4: Flat 40 / grows from 10 to 40 as you earn titles

column2: Do we build a consensual duel system?
column3: The Unrivaled now depends on it - the title has no unlock condition without a duel ledger. It is a whole subsystem - challenge and accept - win detection - a persistent win counter - and rules for forfeits - disconnects and ties. Nothing else in the mod needs PvP infrastructure
column4: Full duel system with challenge/accept / piggyback on an existing PvP mod / drop the duel idea and give The Unrivaled a different contested condition

column2: Target 26.1 stable or 26.2 beta?
column3: NeoForge has no stable 26.2 release yet - only 26.2.0.41-beta. 26.1 is stable at 26.1.2.93
column5: OBSOLETE - superseded by the 1.20.1 decision. Re-ask at port time and take whatever is stable then. Do not pin a version now.

column2: Which mods exactly are we integrating with?
column3: Nothing downstream can be pinned until this list exists. It decides the Gradle dependencies - the API surface we compile against - and how much of Phase 6 survives the port
column4: List each mod with its 1.20.1 Forge version and whether it exposes a real API or needs reflection
column5: MOSTLY ANSWERED - see the Integration Targets sheet. Cisco's Dragonfyre read in full from its manifest - Soulrend and Beyond Depth partially. Answer - exactly TWO things need code - attributeslib as a compat class and a clean /titles grant command. Everything else is datapack JSON. Prominence II is CUT - it is a Fabric pack and Sinytra Connector cannot run a Forge mod on Fabric. Still open - read the Soulrend and Beyond Depth manifests to confirm

column2: Do any integration targets already have a 26.x version?
column3: If most do the port gets far more valuable. If none do then the ported build serves a different audience entirely and the integrations become dead weight
column4: Check each one on Modrinth and CurseForge before committing to the port
column5: MUCH SMALLER NOW - only attributeslib actually matters since it is our one compat class. Everything else is datapack JSON that survives the port untouched regardless of what those mods do

column2: Does any integration need more than a soft dependency?
column3: A mod we genuinely cannot function without changes the whole compat story and would make the port hostage to their update schedule
column4: All soft / one is effectively required
column5: ANSWERED - all soft. Nothing is required. The two things that need code both degrade cleanly - the attributeslib effects skip silently when it is absent and the command works standalone

column2: Does Epic Fight bypass vanilla attack attributes?
column3: Soulrend is built on Epic Fight. If it handles damage without consulting attack_damage then every damage title is silently inert in that pack and no amount of balancing fixes it
column4: Test in-game once we have a working build / find another lever for that pack / accept damage titles do nothing there
column5: The single highest-risk unknown on the Integration Targets sheet. Cannot be resolved on paper
